Please like, share, comment The Oklahoma City Thunder may have won the game against the LA Clippers, but they lost something much bigger. With just 1:14 left in the 4th quarter, OKC All-Star guard Jalen Williams drove to the basket for a dunk and was hit hard by Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. in mid-air. JDub fell awkwardly, pinning his left leg underneath his body weight in a gruesome, terrifying lower-leg injury. You could hear a pin drop inside the Paycom Center as a towel was immediately thrown over his leg and medical staff rushed out with a stretcher. The reactions from his teammates were painful to watch—Chet Holmgren covered his eyes in shock, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was seen fighting back tears with his jersey over his face. But the LAST moment is absolutely heartbreaking. As JDub was being stretchered off the floor, the entire arena broke into a standing ovation, chanting his name and letting out a chorus of the famous Thunder barks. Through absolute agony, Jalen Williams looked up and gave the home crowd two thumbs up.
